def spiral(i,dirs_order=[(-1,0),(0,1),(1,0),(0,-1)],L0=1,Lstep=1,grow=True,blocked_draw=True):
    h=len(i);w=len(i[0]); rs,cs=[(r,c) for r in range(h) for c in range(w) if i[r][c]==3][0]; sr,sc=rs,cs
    obs={(r,c) for r in range(h) for c in range(w) if i[r][c]==2}
    dirs=dirs_order; d=dirs[0]; seg=0; L=L0
    out=[[0]*w for _ in range(h)]; out[sr][sc]=3
    pos=(sr,sc)
    while True:
        nr,nc=pos[0]+d[0],pos[1]+d[1]
        if 0<=nr<h and 0<=nc<w and i[nr][nc]!=2 and i[nr][nc]==0 and (nr,nc) not in {(a,b) for a in range(h) for b in range(w) if out[a][b]}:
            out[nr][nc]=3; pos=(nr,nc); seg+=1
            if seg==L: d=dirs[(dirs.index(d)+1)%4]; seg=0; L+=Lstep
        else:
            d=dirs[(dirs.index(d)+1)%4]; seg=0; break
    return out
